# The backend message database link uses a logical documentation route

The Mail Back End toctree includes /backend/message_database. The documentation configuration maps backend to mailnews/base/docs, where message_database.md lives. The chapter also links to the separately mapped /panorama/index route. These rooted documentation links are not literal repository source paths. Static route and source checks establish this mapping; no rendered-link or Sphinx build result was obtained.

Scope: Thunderbird source documentation routing.
